AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.label: Crownfire Rocket Choir
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.description: Main weapon core for medium modular turret chassis. A vertical split-warhead rocket choir that launches one sealed carrier from alternating crownfire silos; the carrier opens above the chassis and releases eight guided micro-rockets into hostile clusters.
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.effectSummary: Primary missile module. Fires one vertical carrier rocket from alternating launch silos. The carrier splits shortly after launch into 8 fast guided micro-rockets that distribute across hostile targets near the original aim point. Excellent anti-swarm and anti-breach saturation; expensive, power hungry, and inefficient against isolated armored bosses.
